Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1153722. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1153722'. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
